sourceAuthority.scope: Complete Office page within the incumbent R.W.H identity; no global redesign.
sourceAuthority.content: PRODUCT.md, OFFICE_CONTENT.json and office.py retain complete Office content while separating introduction, mission, qualification and qualification date by meaning; this supersedes the earlier short Apollo statement and parallel-language layout.
sourceAuthority.style: dist/office.css and dist/office-page.js; current source declarations, cascade and partner state behavior are documented in DESIGN.md.
sourceAuthority.detectorAdvisories: Distinct gray counts represent context-specific neutral roles. Font-size counts represent documented Office, shell and responsive roles; the shared family remains Roboto.
sourceAuthority.media: OFFICE_MEDIA.json retains five original media assets and both source GIFs. Displayed lossless panoramas reconstruct all distinct logo content from overlapping timeline frames with ffmpeg crop+hstack: partners-01-complete.png (3057×112), sampled at 5, 10, 15, 20, 26 seconds; partners-02-complete.png (2453×135), sampled at 5, 10, 15, 20 seconds. Sampling/crop provenance and source/display hashes are recorded in the metadata. Initial single frames omit later brands.
sourceAuthority.language: VI/EN switches whole-page prose, strong phrases, service list items, the pause/resume label and accessible image text; embedded source artwork stays unchanged.
sourceAuthority.partnerScrolling: Both complete panorama sequences have identical duplicate groups for seamless leftward Web Animations API loops at 64px/s. Measured group width includes trailing space: 64px desktop, 32px mobile. Images are width:auto/max-width:none, with heights 112px/135px desktop and 72px/86px mobile. Animated rows clip overflow with 18px edge fades and no bottom padding; row gaps are 28px desktop and 16px mobile. Pause offscreen, on hidden pages, during hover/focus/touch, with no visible pause/resume control (explicit user request). Reduced motion or no animation API retains complete focusable overflow-x:auto rows with native scrollbars and 12px bottom padding; duplicates stay hidden.
sourceAuthority.typographyLayout: Desktop≥1001px uses a centered900px editorial block with16px/1.65 prose, bold700 h2/h3,56px section gaps and8px chronology row spacing. The supplied later reference supersedes the previous full-grid stretch. Tablet retains90%/76ch, mobile retains its current layout and16px/1.75 prose. Strong phrases remain500. Existing Roboto300/400/500 plus self-hosted700 Latin/Vietnamese subsets preserve the family and neutral palette.
sourceAuthority.browserEvidence: evidence/office-reference-20261027/ records the latest supplied-reference refinement: centered desktop column, bold headings in VI/EN, no visible pause control and responsive measurements. Earlier evidence folders describe historical versions.
sourceAuthority.mobileOffice: Office-only mobile refinement at≤767px:44px rail,20px insets,compact24px-top header; portrait beside leadership, two-column team links, full map;16px/1.75 prose; left-aligned ruled service groups;72px/86px partner rows. Below360px portrait stays next to founder and board spans a new row. See evidence/office-mobile-20261027/ for VI/EN browser captures and responsive checks.

narrative.overview:
This documents the built R.W.H identity: large architectural photography, the existing wordmark, restrained sans-serif text, white reading surfaces and charcoal navigation/footer surfaces. Its hierarchy comes from image scale, whitespace and light typography. Preserve that incumbent world when adding screens.

Office is a separate `/office` extension presenting the complete parent R.W.H Office content and image relationships within the current R.W.H shell. Leadership, teams, the founder portrait and map lead into biography, philosophy, signature, Customer Dream, Japan/Vietnam services and two partner-logo strips. Vietnamese and English are whole-page language states. The parent page supplies content and original artwork; the incumbent Roboto typography, neutral palette, shared menu and footer remain the visual authority.
keyCharacteristics: Photography leads the portfolio; Office combines complete source content, original imagery and open editorial spacing.
Neutral surfaces and thin functional strokes.
Quiet uppercase navigation and a persistent right-edge menu control.
Shared wordmark, language controls, navigation, footer and dialogs.

rules.name: The Image Color Rule
rules.body: Keep interface colors neutral; do not introduce a new decorative accent for Office.

rules.name: The Incumbent Type Rule
rules.body: Apply the current R.W.H Roboto hierarchy to Office prose; preserve lettering that is already part of original image artwork.

dos: Do preserve the incumbent R.W.H wordmark, Roboto hierarchy, neutral palette, photography, menu and footer.
Do retain the full Office content sequence and its original portrait, map, signature and partner artwork.
Do switch the complete page prose between Vietnamese and English with the shared language control.
Do keep both partner panoramas complete, loop them left seamlessly without a visible pause/resume line, and provide complete static horizontal rows for reduced motion or an unavailable animation API.
Do retain clear keyboard focus, wrapping labels and the existing mobile touch targets.
donts: Don't redesign the portfolio or replace its shared navigation/footer to match the Office composition.
Don't restore the superseded short Apollo-style statement or simultaneous Vietnamese/English prose columns.
Don't adopt the parent page's burgundy palette or condensed type for the current interface.
Don't turn Office prose into cards, crop partner logos or recolor original image artwork.
Don't treat overridden glass-modal CSS as the current contact design.
